cells.name: Continuity and responsiveness
cells.example: T3 answers T2 directly; T4 and T5 respond to T3.
cells.limitation: T6-T9 affirm the agreed plan rather than take up anything new.

cells.name: Development of ideas
cells.example: T6 adds reintroduction one at a time with an observation interval.
cells.limitation: After T6 no turn adds a distinction; T7-T8 restate the plan.

cells.name: Exploration of central tensions
cells.example: Speed versus safety framed in T2-T3.
cells.limitation: Irritation versus allergy, patch testing, and active ingredients never raised by any mind.

cells.name: Integration of perspectives
cells.example: T5 Pragmatist folds efficiency into the reset plan.
cells.limitation: Forced agreement by T5; ingredient-reading idea from T2 dropped though compatible with stopping.

cells.name: Progress toward understanding
cells.example: Section D ends on a clear stop, recover, reintroduce plan.
cells.limitation: Open question in D about incompatibility is stated, not sharpened by the debate.

cells.name: Faithful engagement
cells.example: T3 engages T2's proposal to guess the culprit.
cells.limitation: T3 treats T2 as continued exposure; T2 proposed reading ingredients, not continued use.

cells.name: Substance of challenges
cells.example: T3: guesswork under stress risks further damage.
cells.limitation: T3 names no assumption or mechanism; T4-T5 accept rather than test it.

cells.name: Accuracy and support
cells.example: Stop all, recover, reintroduce singly is broadly standard advice (T6, E).
cells.limitation: Tabula rasa attributed to Bacon (T1) suspected; three-day gap may miss delayed allergic reactions (E).

cells.name: Calibration and transparency
cells.example: Section E branches on whether stinging persists.
cells.limitation: T3 asserts skin fragility, T4 a system already failing, without evidence of severity.

cells.name: Intellectual honesty and revision
cells.example: T5 concedes the efficiency push overlooked the cost of error.
cells.limitation: T4-T5 concede wholesale, restating T3 without narrowing; T2's valid point abandoned.

cells.name: Identification of the actual concern
cells.example: Section A names both finding the culprit and managing discomfort.
cells.limitation: Never asks whether stinging is expected tingle from actives or a true reaction.

cells.name: Meaningful use of personal context
cells.example: Three products started together drives the stop-all reasoning in T1.
cells.limitation: The one-week timeline and stinging symptom never shape the argument beyond T1.

cells.name: Fit with goals and values
cells.example: Plan in T6-T7 serves the user's goal of identifying the cause.
cells.limitation: Whether the user wants to keep using the products is never considered.

cells.name: Attention to constraints and stakes
cells.example: T8 notes trading short-term speed for a working routine.
cells.limitation: Severity, warning signs, and cost of discarding products unaddressed anywhere.

cells.name: Responsiveness to information
cells.example: Section E branches on whether stinging stops after stopping products.
cells.limitation: No question or branch on product types, ingredients, or severity.

cells.name: Clarification of desires and motivations
cells.example: None; T8 mentions wanting a routine that works.
cells.limitation: No plausible motives offered, such as keeping a costly product or a skin goal.

cells.name: Examination of assumptions
cells.example: Section D notes some products may be inherently incompatible.
cells.limitation: User's assumption of a single culprit, versus a combination, never examined in turns.

cells.name: Clarification of values and priorities
cells.example: T2-T3 set speed against safety.
cells.limitation: The user's own priority between speed and safety is never asked.

cells.name: Recognition of fears and outside expectations
cells.example: T3 voices worry about further damage.
cells.limitation: No attention to the user's own worry or the sunk cost of new products.

cells.name: Agency and reflective ownership
cells.example: Section E offers branches the user can follow.
cells.limitation: T3 'You must' and no questions leave nothing for the user to accept or refine.

cells.name: Definition of the decision and options
cells.example: T1-T2 set stop-all against targeting the likely irritant.
cells.limitation: Patch testing on a small area and stopping only the likely culprit never offered.

cells.name: Explanation of tradeoffs
cells.example: T8: trade short-term speed for a long-term solution.
cells.limitation: Cost of stopping all, such as lost weeks and lost benefits, left unweighed.

cells.name: Identification of decisive conditions
cells.example: Section E: stinging persists means seek medical advice; stops means reintroduce.
cells.limitation: Three-day gap in E is ungrounded; no warning signs like swelling marking urgent care.

cells.name: Treatment of uncertainty
cells.example: Section D notes uncertainty about eventual compatibility.
cells.limitation: Irritant versus allergic reaction, the consequential unknown, never separated.

cells.name: Proportionate next steps
cells.example: Stop all, wait for healing, reintroduce singly (T6-T7, E).
cells.limitation: Section A names managing discomfort, yet no step addresses soothing the stinging now.

cells.name: Accessible language
cells.example: T6 explains reintroduction plainly.
cells.limitation: Abstract 'system' framing in T3-T4 where skin would read more plainly.

cells.name: Traceable arguments and references
cells.example: T4 names the Risk Analyst it agrees with.
cells.limitation: T3 'That is a dangerous gamble' and T7 'This' loosely refer back.

cells.name: Manageable pacing and turn length
cells.example: Nine turns, all within word range per deterministic checks.
cells.limitation: T7-T9 slack after consensus, pacing flattens.

cells.name: Distinguishable positions and voices
cells.example: T2 Pragmatist briefly distinct with its efficiency push.
cells.limitation: After T5 all three minds speak alike in one formal register.

cells.name: Economy and sustained attention
cells.example: T6 states the plan once clearly.
cells.limitation: T7 and T8 repeat T6's plan without adding anything.

cells.name: Meaningful stakes and tension
cells.example: T3 frames risk of further damage.
cells.limitation: Tension resolved by T5; remaining turns carry no stakes.

cells.name: Surprise and reversals
cells.example: T5 Pragmatist reverses on efficiency.
cells.limitation: T4-T5 reversals restate T3 without narrowing; scripted, not argued.

cells.name: Personality and expressive voice
cells.example: T1 tabula rasa gives Empiricist slight flavor.
cells.limitation: Flat, interchangeable voices; Taleb's figure lacks any characteristic edge.

cells.name: Memorable delivery
cells.example: T9: the skin is the ultimate judge of your strategy.
cells.limitation: No analogy or vivid example; lines generic throughout T4-T8.

cells.name: Anticipation and emotional movement
cells.example: Brief friction T2-T3.
cells.limitation: Uniform rhythm; consensus at T5 removes all movement.

strengths: Section E gives observable branches: stinging persists versus stops, each with an action.
T6 states a safe, broadly standard stop-and-reintroduce plan clearly.
T5 Pragmatist names why it concedes: the cost of error.
weaknesses: No mind asks about product types, actives or severity; C3.5 and C5.4 suffer.
Forced consensus by T5 drops the Pragmatist's compatible ingredient-reading idea.
T6-T9 repeat the plan in one flat shared voice; no development or drama.

symptoms.observed: No question or branch on which products, actives, or severity of stinging.
symptoms.evidence: look at the ingredients and identify the most likely irritant

symptoms.observed: Both opponents capitulate to T3 wholesale; ingredient idea never integrated.
symptoms.evidence: I concede. My previous push for efficiency was flawed

symptoms.observed: T3 treats ingredient reading as continued exposure, which T2 never proposed.
symptoms.evidence: adding guesswork or continuing any exposure is a recipe

symptoms.observed: No step addresses easing current stinging despite Section A naming it.
symptoms.evidence: We wait for the skin to heal, then apply

symptoms.observed: After consensus all minds speak in one formal register, interchangeable.
symptoms.evidence: It is the most effective way to reach a working routine

findings.description: Tabula rasa is more associated with Locke; Novum Organum speaks of clearing idols, not skin baselines.
Three-day reintroduction gap not derived from user facts; delayed allergic reactions can take longer.
Taleb fragility framing paraphrased without quotation; fidelity to Antifragile not assessable here.

rubric_fit_notes: Troubleshooting question gives few personal details, so criterion 4 has limited natural material; low ratings reflect that the debate offered no reflective questions at all. The ungrounded_number entry refers to Section E, which has no turn number.
question_type_note: Read as a decision about how to isolate the irritant, so stop-all versus targeting versus patch testing defines the options.
